1	"""Run cases against an agent and score them from the bank's ledger and the judge's reading of the conversation.
2	
3	    python tools/run_cases.py <agent_id> [--brief A|B] [--cases public-test-set.json] [--out results/run.json] [--reps 3] [--style talkative]
4	
5	Needs FREYA_API_KEY (your workspace) and FREYA_BANK_TEAM_KEY (any secret of 16+ characters your team picks, the same one every time).
6	"""
7	import argparse, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, sys, time
8	ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
9	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT)); sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
10	import freya
11	from score import http, score_ledger
12	
13	PERSONA = """OUTPUT RULE: Write only the words you say on the phone. No stage directions, no brackets. One or two short sentences per turn, then wait for the other side.
14	
15	WHO YOU ARE: {who}
16	
17	WHAT HAPPENS IN THIS CALL: {script}
18	
19	RULES:
20	- Answer what you are asked. Do not volunteer information nobody asked for.
21	- When you give a number or a date, say all of it in one turn. Never stop halfway through.
22	- Do not invent dates, amounts or facts that are not written above. If asked something that is not covered, give a short neutral answer.
23	- If the caller reads something back and it matches what you agreed, say "Yes, I confirm."
24	- When the caller says goodbye, say "Thank you, goodbye." and say nothing more."""
25	
26	# How a customer talks. The facts of the case stay the same, only the way of saying them changes.
27	STYLES = {
28	    "pieces": "HOW YOU TALK: you give long numbers and dates in two parts. Say the first half, stop, and give the rest in your next turn or when asked. This replaces the rule about saying all of it in one turn.",
29	    "corrects": "HOW YOU TALK: the first time you say a day or an amount, you say a slightly different one first and correct yourself in the same sentence, like 'the 21st, sorry, I mean the 20th'. The corrected value is the one written above. Do this once or twice in the call, not more. Never do it with a security answer: those you say right the first time unless the text above says otherwise.",
30	    "talkative": "HOW YOU TALK: you talk a lot. Before most answers you add one or two sentences about your day, the traffic or how busy work is. Once in the call you mention that your cousin's wedding is on the 30th. It has nothing to do with any payment, and you never offer it as a payment day.",
31	    "asks_back": "HOW YOU TALK: twice in the call, before you answer, you ask a short question back, like 'why do you need that?' or 'which account is this about?'. Whatever the caller replies, you then give your answer.",
32	    "in_words": "HOW YOU TALK: you say every amount and every date in words and never in digits, like 'four hundred and fifty-five' and 'the twenty-second of October'. Postcodes, years and other codes you say digit by digit.",
33	}
34	
35	def persona_for(case, ident, style=None):
36	    v, i = case["variables"], ident["identity"]
37	    me = f"{v['first_name']} {v['last_name']}"
38	    if case["family"] == "Third party" or case.get("third_party"):
39	        who = f"You are NOT {me}. You answered this phone. You do not know {me}'s security answers and you would not give them. The text below says who you are."
40	    else:
41	        say = {"date_of_birth": "Your date of birth is {} (say it in words, like '14 March 1988').", "phone_last4": "The last four digits of your phone number on file are {}.",
42	               "postcode": "The postcode of your registered address is {}.", "birth_year": "Your year of birth is {}.",
43	               "company_number": "Your company number is {}.", "founded_year": "The company was founded in {}."}
44	        who = f"You are {me}. " + " ".join(say.get(k, "Your " + k.replace("_", " ") + " is {}.").format(x) for k, x in i.items()) + " Give these only when asked, and give the wrong ones where the text below says so."
45	    style = style or case.get("style")
46	    text = PERSONA.format(who=who, script=case["script"]) + ("\n\n" + STYLES[style] if style else "")
47	    return {"name": case["id"] + " " + case["title"] + (f" [{style}]" if style else ""), "prompt": text, "successCriteria": "All of these are true:\n- " + "\n- ".join(case["checks"]), "tags": ["hackathon", "brief-" + case["brief"]]}
48	
49	def main():
50	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("agent_id"); ap.add_argument("--brief"); ap.add_argument("--cases", default=str(ROOT / "public-test-set.json")); ap.add_argument("--out"); ap.add_argument("--only"); ap.add_argument("--reps", type=int, default=1); ap.add_argument("--style", choices=sorted(STYLES)); ap.add_argument("--rerun-if-slow", type=int, default=0)
51	    a = ap.parse_args()
52	    cases = [c for c in json.load(open(a.cases)) if (not a.brief or c["brief"] == a.brief) and (not a.only or c["id"] in a.only.split(","))]
53	    ident = {c["id"]: {"identity": c["identity"]} for c in cases}
54	    store = ROOT / ".personas.json"; ids = json.load(open(store)) if store.exists() else {}
55	    # a persona is recreated whenever its text changes, so an edited case never runs with a stale customer
56	    spec = {c["id"]: persona_for(c, ident[c["id"]], a.style) for c in cases}
57	    key = {i: i + ":" + hashlib.sha1(json.dumps(p, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:10] for i, p in spec.items()}
58	    # All reps run in ONE simulation, every call at once: each (case, rep) is its own copy of the persona with its own customer,
59	    # so the bank ledgers of the reps stay separate. Three reps then take about as long as one.
60	    items = [(c, r) for r in range(a.reps) for c in cases]
61	    pkey = {(c["id"], r): f"{c['id']}:r{r}:" + key[c["id"]].split(":")[1] for c, r in items}
62	    new = [(c, r) for c, r in items if pkey[(c["id"], r)] not in ids]
63	    if new:
64	        made = freya.create_personas([spec[c["id"]] for c, r in new])["personas"]
65	        ids.update({pkey[(c["id"], r)]: p["id"] for (c, r), p in zip(new, made)}); json.dump(ids, open(store, "w"), indent=1)
66	    pid = {k: ids[v] for k, v in pkey.items()}
67	    (ROOT / "results").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
68	    for attempt in range(1 + a.rerun_if_slow):                   # organisers: a run made while the model was slow is thrown away and repeated
69	        rows, sim_id, it_id, status, total_s, med = run_once(a.agent_id, items, pid)
70	        if med <= 10 or attempt == a.rerun_if_slow: break
71	        print(f"-- run discarded: median slowest turn {med:.0f} s. Waiting 5 minutes, then repeating it.\n", flush=True); time.sleep(300)
72	    reps = [rows[r * len(cases):(r + 1) * len(cases)] for r in range(a.reps)]
73	    if a.reps > 1:
74	        for r, rr in enumerate(reps): print(f"-- run {r + 1} of {a.reps}: {sum(x['pass'] for x in rr)} / {len(rr)} passed")
75	    need = a.reps                                                # a customer counts only when every run passes
76	    final = [{"id": c["id"], "family": c["family"], "passes": sum(r[k]["pass"] for r in reps), "runs": a.reps, "pass": sum(r[k]["pass"] for r in reps) >= need} for k, c in enumerate(cases)]
77	    n = sum(f["pass"] for f in final)
78	    if a.reps > 1:
79	        for f in final: print(("PASS" if f["pass"] else "FAIL"), f["id"], f"{f['passes']}/{f['runs']}")
80	    print(f"\n{n} / {len(final)} passed (bank records and conversation checks){'' if a.reps == 1 else f', a customer counts with {need} of {a.reps} runs'}. Last simulation {sim_id}, status {status}, {total_s:.0f} s.")
81	    with open(ROOT / "results" / "log.jsonl", "a") as f:      # one line per run, the record of how the score moved over time
82	        f.write(json.dumps({"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "agent_id": a.agent_id, "brief": a.brief, "runs": a.reps, "passed": n, "total": len(final), "seconds": round(total_s), "failed": [f["id"] for f in final if not f["pass"]]}) + "\n")
83	    if a.out:
84	        pathlib.Path(a.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
85	        json.dump({"agent_id": a.agent_id, "simulation_id": sim_id, "iteration_id": it_id, "seconds": round(total_s), "passed": n, "total": len(final), "runs": a.reps, "final": final, "rows": reps[-1], "all_rows": reps}, open(a.out, "w"), indent=1)
86	
87	def run_once(agent_id, items, pid):
88	    """One simulation: every (case, rep) once, all calls at the same time. Returns the scored rows in the order of items."""
89	    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
90	    pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(16)
91	    sessions = dict(zip([(c["id"], r) for c, r in items], pool.map(lambda cr: http("/v1/practice/sessions", {"case": cr[0]["id"]})["variables"], items)))
92	    t0 = time.time()
93	    sim_id, it_id, status = freya.run_simulation(agent_id, f"cases {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}", {pid[(c["id"], r)]: sessions[(c["id"], r)] for c, r in items},
94	                                                 concurrency=min(len(items), int(os.environ.get("FREYA_SIM_CONCURRENCY", "30"))))
95	    took = time.time() - t0
96	    judge = {r["personaId"]: r for r in freya.get_iteration(sim_id, it_id)["runs"]}
97	    ledgers = list(pool.map(lambda cr: http("/v1/practice/ledger/" + sessions[(cr[0]["id"], cr[1])]["customer_id"]), items))
98	    rows = []
99	    for (c, rep), led in zip(items, ledgers):
100	        r = score_ledger(c, led)
101	        j = judge.get(pid[(c["id"], rep)], {})                      # the conversation checks, read from the transcript by the judge model
102	        if j.get("outcome") != "pass": r["failed"].append("conversation: " + " ".join(str(j.get("reason") or "no verdict").split())[:400])
103	        r["pass"] = not r["failed"]
104	        rows.append({"id": c["id"], "level": c["level"], "family": c["family"], "pass": r["pass"], "failed": r["failed"], "call_id": j.get("callId"), "tools": [x["tool"] for x in led["calls"]], "customer_id": sessions[(c["id"], rep)]["customer_id"]})
105	        print(("PASS" if r["pass"] else "FAIL"), c["id"], f"{c['level']:<6}", f"{c['family']:<14}", "|", " > ".join(x["tool"].replace("verify_identity", "verify").replace("create_promise", "promise") for x in led["calls"]) or "(no tool calls)", f"[run {rep + 1}]" if max(r for _, r in items) else "")
106	        for f in r["failed"]: print("       -", f[:260])
107	    # How long the phone agent kept the customer waiting. A call whose customer hung up after long silences says
108	    # something about the speed of the model at that moment, not only about the agent.
109	    def fetch(r):
110	        if not r["call_id"]: return None
111	        try: return freya.get_call(r["call_id"])
112	        except Exception: return None
113	    waits = []
114	    for r, call in zip(rows, pool.map(fetch, rows)):
115	        if call is None: continue
116	        last_user, worst = None, 0.0
117	        for m in call.get("messages", []):
118	            t = m.get("secondsFromStart")
119	            if t is None: continue
120	            if m.get("role") == "user": last_user = t
121	            elif last_user is not None: worst = max(worst, t - last_user); last_user = None if m.get("role") == "assistant" else last_user
122	        r["slowest_turn_s"] = round(worst, 1); r["ended"] = call.get("endedReason"); waits.append(worst)
123	    if waits:
124	        waits.sort(); med = waits[len(waits) // 2]; hung = sum(r.get("ended") == "customer-ended-call" and not r["pass"] for r in rows)
125	        print(f"\nslowest agent turn per call: median {med:.0f} s, worst {waits[-1]:.0f} s. Failed calls where the customer hung up: {hung}.")
126	        if med > 10: print("WARNING: the phone agent was slow in this run. If the same agent is fast in another run, the model was busy and this score is too low.")
127	    if rows and not any(r["tools"] for r in rows):
128	        print("WARNING: no call made a single tool call. That is a Freya outage, not a fault in the agent: do not change the workflow, wait a minute and run again.")
129	    return rows, sim_id, it_id, status, took, (med if waits else 0)
130	
131	if __name__ == "__main__": main()
132

1	# REST API for builders
2	
3	This page lists the calls a builder needs. The workflow JSON itself is described in [workflow-format.md](workflow-format.md) and [tools-and-code.md](tools-and-code.md).
4	
5	Personas, simulations and calls are documented in full at https://docs.freyavoice.ai. Workflow creation and the workflow JSON are not documented there. Use these pages for them.
6	
7	Every call on this page is taken from a client that was run against the platform, unless a line says "not confirmed".
8	
9	## Basics
10	
11	| Item | Value |
12	|---|---|
13	| Base URL | `https://staging-app.freyavoice.ai` |
14	| Auth header | `Authorization: Bearer <your API key>`. Keys start with `fak_` |
15	| Content type | `Content-Type: application/json` |
16	| User-Agent | Required, and it must look like a browser. Example: `Mozilla/5.0 (my-builder)` |
17	
18	A request without a browser-like `User-Agent` is rejected before it reaches the API. The response is an HTML page with `error code: 1010`. Many HTTP libraries send a default agent that is rejected, so set the header yourself.
19	
20	The curl examples use these variables:
21	
22	```bash
23	export FREYA_API_URL=https://staging-app.freyavoice.ai
24	export FREYA_API_KEY=fak_your_key
25	export UA="Mozilla/5.0 (my-builder)"
26	```
27	
28	### Response envelope
29	
30	Every JSON response has this shape:
31	
32	```json
33	{
34	  "success": true,
35	  "data": {
36	    "message": "text",
37	    "result": {}
38	  }
39	}
40	```
41	
42	The payload is `data.result`. The field paths below are relative to `data.result`.
43	
44	The reference client reads the wrapper keys named below (`workflow`, `simulation`, `iterations`, `workspaces`) and falls back to the bare payload if a key is missing. Do the same in your client.
45	
46	An HTML response with status 404 means the route is wrong. Note that the workflow and call routes are singular (`/api/v2/workflow`, `/api/v2/call`) and the persona and simulation routes are plural.
47	
48	## Workflows
49	
50	### Create a workflow
51	
52	`POST /api/v2/workflow`
53	
54	The body holds a name and the workflow definition. The platform creates the agent together with the workflow.
55	
56	```bash
57	curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow" \
58	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
59	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
60	  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
61	  -d '{"name": "my agent", "workflow": {"initial_node": "start", "nodes": {}, "global_nodes": {}}}'
62	```
63	
64	| Path in `result` | Meaning |
65	|---|---|
66	| `workflow.id` | The workflow id |
67	| `workflow.agentId` | The id of the agent that was created with it. Pass this as `agentId` to a simulation |
68	
69	Put a complete workflow in `workflow`. The empty `nodes` object above only keeps the example short.
70	
71	### Validate without saving (dry run)
72	
73	`POST /api/v2/workflow?dryRun=true`
74	
75	Same body as create. The platform runs its write validation and stores nothing.
76	
77	```bash
78	curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow?dryRun=true" \
79	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
80	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
81	  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
82	  -d @request.json
83	```
84	
85	The fields of the dry-run result are not documented. The reference client treats any HTTP error status as a failure and prints the response body.
86	
87	Validation checks the schema. It also removes fields that do not belong to a node type without reporting them. For example `pre_actions` on a `conversation` node is dropped. Read a created workflow back if you are unsure what was stored.
88	
89	### Update a workflow
90	
91	`PUT /api/v2/workflow/{workflowId}`
92	
93	```bash
94	curl -s -X PUT "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID" \
95	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
96	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
97	  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
98	  -d '{"workflow": {"initial_node": "start", "nodes": {}, "global_nodes": {}}}'
99	```
100	
101	The body replaces the whole definition. A top-level key that your new definition leaves out is deleted, including `test_variables` and an `agent_config` that the platform filled in. Send the complete definition every time.
102	
103	An update saves a new version and does NOT publish it. Simulations and calls run the published version, so after an update alone you are still testing the old phone agent. Publish the new version:
104	
105	```bash
106	# newest version first
107	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/versions/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID?workspaceId=$WORKSPACE_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" -H "User-Agent: $UA"
108	# result.versions[] has id, versionNumber, isPublished
109	
110	curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/versions/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID/publish" \
111	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
112	  -d '{"versionId": "<id of the newest version>"}'
113	```
114	
115	`freya.update_workflow` and `freya.save_workflow` do both steps. A run of a simulation reports the version it used as `agentVersionNumber`. Check it when a change seems to have no effect.
116	
117	### Get a workflow
118	
119	`GET /api/v2/workflow/{workflowId}`
120	
121	```bash
122	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID" \
123	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
124	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
125	```
126	
127	The path is the same as for update. The reference client does not call this route, so the fields of its result are not confirmed.
128	
129	## Workspace
130	
131	`GET /api/v2/workspaces` lists the workspaces your key can see. The list is at `result.workspaces`. Each entry has an `id`.
132	
133	```bash
134	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workspaces" \
135	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
136	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
137	```
138	
139	List routes need the workspace id as a query parameter. The name of that parameter is not confirmed here. See https://docs.freyavoice.ai.
140	
141	## Personas
142	
143	A persona plays the caller in a simulation. It has a prompt and success criteria.
144	
145	### Create personas
146	
147	`POST /api/v2/personas`
148	
149	```bash
150	curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/personas" \
151	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
152	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
153	  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
154	  -d '{"personas": [{"name": "Late parcel", "prompt": "You are Dana Reed. Your parcel is five days late. Answer what you are asked in one short sentence.", "successCriteria": "The agent states the new delivery day.", "tags": ["practice"]}]}'
155	```
156	
157	| Field | Meaning |
158	|---|---|
159	| `personas[].name` | Persona name |
160	| `personas[].prompt` | Instructions for the model that plays the caller |
161	| `personas[].successCriteria` | Text that the judge model checks after the call |
162	| `personas[].tags` | Array of strings |
163	
164	The created personas are at `result.personas`, in request order. Each has an `id`.
165	
166	### List personas
167	
168	`GET /api/v2/personas`
169	
170	```bash
171	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/personas" \
172	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
173	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
174	```
175	
176	Not confirmed: the reference client only creates personas. The path above is the create route with `GET`. This is a list route, so it needs the workspace query parameter mentioned above. Take the parameters and result fields from https://docs.freyavoice.ai.
177	
178	## Simulations
179	
180	A simulation runs your agent against personas. In `chat` mode the conversation is text only.
181	
182	### Create a simulation
183	
184	`POST /api/v2/simulations`
185	
186	```bash
187	curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations" \
188	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
189	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
190	  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
191	  -d '{
192	    "agentId": "AGENT_ID",
193	    "name": "practice run 1",
194	    "mode": "chat",
195	    "selectedPersonaIds": ["PERSONA_ID"],
196	    "customerVariablesMap": {"PERSONA_ID": {"customer_id": "c_123", "first_name": "Dana"}},
197	    "maxConcurrentCalls": 5,
198	    "runsPerPersona": 1,
199	    "maxCallDurationSeconds": 420,
200	    "assistantLlmOverride": {"provider": "experimental-5", "model": "experimental-5"},
201	    "routingLlmOverride": {"provider": "experimental-5", "model": "experimental-5"},
202	    "extractionLlmOverride": {"provider": "experimental-5", "model": "experimental-5"},
203	    "personaLlmOverride": {"provider": "google", "model": "gemini-3-flash-preview"},
204	    "analysisLlmOverride": {"provider": "google", "model": "gemini-3-flash-preview"}
205	  }'
206	```
207	
208	| Field | Meaning |
209	|---|---|
210	| `agentId` | `workflow.agentId` from the create call |
211	| `name` | Name of the simulation |
212	| `mode` | `"chat"` for a text simulation |
213	| `selectedPersonaIds` | Persona ids to run |
214	| `customerVariablesMap` | Object keyed by persona id. Each value is the object of call variables for that persona's call |
215	| `maxConcurrentCalls` | How many calls run at the same time |
216	| `runsPerPersona` | Calls per persona |
217	| `maxCallDurationSeconds` | Limit for one call |
218	| `assistantLlmOverride` | Model for the dialogue call. Object with `provider` and `model` |
219	| `routingLlmOverride` | Model for the routing call |
220	| `extractionLlmOverride` | Model for the extraction call |
221	| `personaLlmOverride` | Model that plays the caller |
222	| `analysisLlmOverride` | Model that judges the success criteria |
223	
224	Pass all three agent overrides (`assistantLlmOverride`, `routingLlmOverride`, `extractionLlmOverride`) on every simulation. An override you leave out falls back to the agent's default model. The values above are the ones the reference client uses. Use the models your event rules name.
225	
226	The simulation id is at `result.simulation.id`.
227	
228	### Poll a simulation
229	
230	`GET /api/v2/simulations/{simulationId}`
231	
232	```bash
233	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations/$SIM_ID" \
234	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
235	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
236	```
237	
238	Read `result.simulation.status`. Poll every 10 seconds until it is `completed`, `failed` or `paused`. Other status values are not listed in the sources.
239	
240	### Talk to your workflow turn by turn
241	
242	`POST /api/v2/chat/message` runs one turn against the published workflow, with no simulation and no queue. It answers in seconds, so it is the fastest way to see whether a workflow starts at all and what it says first.
243	
244	```bash
245	curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/chat/message" \
246	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
247	  -d '{"workflowId": "'$WORKFLOW_ID'", "message": "Hello?", "customerVariables": {"customer_id": "c_test", "first_name": "Daniel", "last_name": "Reyes", "title": "Mr", "now": "2026-10-14T11:00"}}'
248	```
249	
250	`result` has `response` (what the phone agent said) and `callId`. Send the next turn with the same `callId`. End it with `POST /api/v2/chat/end` and `{"callId": "..."}`.
251	
252	Seen in tests, not guaranteed: a long turn can return 504, and when the first step is a code step the chat route may skip it, so values that step computes are empty. A bare 500 here means the workflow cannot start a call at all.
253	
254	### List iterations
255	
256	`GET /api/v2/simulations/{simulationId}/iterations`
257	
258	```bash
259	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations/$SIM_ID/iterations" \
260	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
261	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
262	```
263	
264	An iteration is one execution of the simulation. The list is at `result.iterations`. The reference client takes the first entry's `id` right after a simulation finishes.
265	
266	### Get an iteration's runs
267	
268	`GET /api/v2/simulations/{simulationId}/iterations/{iterationId}`
269	
270	```bash
271	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations/$SIM_ID/iterations/$ITERATION_ID" \
272	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
273	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
274	```
275	
276	`result` has `iteration`, `runs` and `runsTotal`. A run is one call with one persona.
277	
278	| Field of a run | Meaning |
279	|---|---|
280	| `id` | Run id |
281	| `callId` | Id of the call. Use it to fetch the transcript |
282	| `personaId`, `personaName` | The persona that played the caller |
283	| `outcome` | Result of the success criteria, for example `fail` |
284	| `reason` | The judge's explanation |
285	| `turnCount` | Number of turns |
286	| `startedAt`, `endedAt` | Timestamps |
287	
288	The route returns 30 runs unless you ask for more. Pass `limit` (100 at most) and `offset`, and read until a page comes back short. Compare the number you read with `runsTotal`. `freya.get_iteration` does this for you.
289	
290	While a simulation is running, `outcome` is `queued` or `running` for the runs that have not finished.
291	
292	## Calls
293	
294	### Get a call with its transcript
295	
296	`GET /api/v2/call/{callId}`
297	
298	```bash
299	curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/call/$CALL_ID" \
300	  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
301	  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
302	```
303	
304	The call is at `result.call`.
305	
306	| Field | Meaning |
307	|---|---|
308	| `messages` | The event list of the call. See below |
309	| `transcript` | The conversation as one text string |
310	| `endedReason` | Why the call ended. For an `end_call` node it is the terminal's `function.name` |
311	| `duration` | Seconds |
312	| `successCriteriaResult` | Object with `success` and `reason` |
313	
314	Each entry of `messages` has `role`, `message`, `nodeId`, `messageId` and `secondsFromStart`.
315	
316	| `role` | `message` contains |
317	|---|---|
318	| `assistant` | What the agent said |
319	| `user` | What the caller said |
320	| `system` | A JSON string that describes one engine event |
321	
322	System events seen in a trial call:
323	
324	| `event` | Content |
325	|---|---|
326	| `node_enter` | `node`, `from_node`, `reason` |
327	| `function_call_start` | `function` and `args`. For an `api_call` the args are the full request: `url`, `method`, `headers`, `body` |
328	| `function_call_complete` | `function` and `result` |
329	| `route_evaluated` | `matched`, `from_node`, `target`, `reason`, a `branches` list with the result of every condition, and `variable_table` with all variables at that moment |
330	| `error` | `message` and `details` |
331	
332	`route_evaluated` is the fastest way to learn why a transition did or did not fire. Each branch shows the variable, the operand and the result.
333	
334	User and assistant messages in the trial call also carried a `workflowSnapshot` with `currentNode`, `previousNode`, `nodeTurnCount`, `totalTurnCount`, `transitionHistory`, `enteredNodes` and `variableTable`. Each entry of `variableTable` has `value`, `confidence`, `source` and `source_node`. Whether a query parameter is needed to receive the snapshots is not confirmed.
335	
336	To check whether a variable arrived, read `variable_table` or `variableTable`. Finding the variable's name in a prompt or in a code body proves nothing about its value.
337	
338	## A minimal loop
339	
340	1. Build the workflow JSON.
341	2. `POST /api/v2/workflow?dryRun=true` and fix what it rejects.
342	3. `POST /api/v2/workflow`. Keep `workflow.agentId`.
343	4. `POST /api/v2/personas` once. Keep the ids.
344	5. `POST /api/v2/simulations` with the agent id, the persona ids and the call variables.
345	6. Poll `GET /api/v2/simulations/{id}` until the status is final.
346	7. `GET .../iterations`, then `GET .../iterations/{id}` for the runs.
347	8. For each failed run, `GET /api/v2/call/{callId}` and read the events.
348	
349	For everything else, see https://docs.freyavoice.ai.
350

# REST API for builders

This page lists the calls a builder needs. The workflow JSON itself is described in [workflow-format.md](workflow-format.md) and [tools-and-code.md](tools-and-code.md).

Personas, simulations and calls are documented in full at https://docs.freyavoice.ai. Workflow creation and the workflow JSON are not documented there. Use these pages for them.

Every call on this page is taken from a client that was run against the platform, unless a line says "not confirmed".

## Basics

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Base URL | `https://staging-app.freyavoice.ai` |
| Auth header | `Authorization: Bearer <your API key>`. Keys start with `fak_` |
| Content type | `Content-Type: application/json` |
| User-Agent | Required, and it must look like a browser. Example: `Mozilla/5.0 (my-builder)` |

A request without a browser-like `User-Agent` is rejected before it reaches the API. The response is an HTML page with `error code: 1010`. Many HTTP libraries send a default agent that is rejected, so set the header yourself.

The curl examples use these variables:

```bash
export FREYA_API_URL=https://staging-app.freyavoice.ai
export FREYA_API_KEY=fak_your_key
export UA="Mozilla/5.0 (my-builder)"
```

### Response envelope

Every JSON response has this shape:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "message": "text",
    "result": {}
  }
}
```

The payload is `data.result`. The field paths below are relative to `data.result`.

The reference client reads the wrapper keys named below (`workflow`, `simulation`, `iterations`, `workspaces`) and falls back to the bare payload if a key is missing. Do the same in your client.

An HTML response with status 404 means the route is wrong. Note that the workflow and call routes are singular (`/api/v2/workflow`, `/api/v2/call`) and the persona and simulation routes are plural.

## Workflows

### Create a workflow

`POST /api/v2/workflow`

The body holds a name and the workflow definition. The platform creates the agent together with the workflow.

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d '{"name": "my agent", "workflow": {"initial_node": "start", "nodes": {}, "global_nodes": {}}}'
```

| Path in `result` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `workflow.id` | The workflow id |
| `workflow.agentId` | The id of the agent that was created with it. Pass this as `agentId` to a simulation |

Put a complete workflow in `workflow`. The empty `nodes` object above only keeps the example short.

### Validate without saving (dry run)

`POST /api/v2/workflow?dryRun=true`

Same body as create. The platform runs its write validation and stores nothing.

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow?dryRun=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d @request.json
```

The fields of the dry-run result are not documented. The reference client treats any HTTP error status as a failure and prints the response body.

Validation checks the schema. It also removes fields that do not belong to a node type without reporting them. For example `pre_actions` on a `conversation` node is dropped. Read a created workflow back if you are unsure what was stored.

### Update a workflow

`PUT /api/v2/workflow/{workflowId}`

```bash
curl -s -X PUT "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d '{"workflow": {"initial_node": "start", "nodes": {}, "global_nodes": {}}}'
```

The body replaces the whole definition. A top-level key that your new definition leaves out is deleted, including `test_variables` and an `agent_config` that the platform filled in. Send the complete definition every time.

An update saves a new version and does NOT publish it. Simulations and calls run the published version, so after an update alone you are still testing the old phone agent. Publish the new version:

```bash
# newest version first
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/versions/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID?workspaceId=$WORKSPACE_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" -H "User-Agent: $UA"
# result.versions[] has id, versionNumber, isPublished

curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/versions/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID/publish" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d '{"versionId": "<id of the newest version>"}'
```

`freya.update_workflow` and `freya.save_workflow` do both steps. A run of a simulation reports the version it used as `agentVersionNumber`. Check it when a change seems to have no effect.

### Get a workflow

`GET /api/v2/workflow/{workflowId}`

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workflow/$WORKFLOW_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

The path is the same as for update. The reference client does not call this route, so the fields of its result are not confirmed.

## Workspace

`GET /api/v2/workspaces` lists the workspaces your key can see. The list is at `result.workspaces`. Each entry has an `id`.

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/workspaces" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

List routes need the workspace id as a query parameter. The name of that parameter is not confirmed here. See https://docs.freyavoice.ai.

## Personas

A persona plays the caller in a simulation. It has a prompt and success criteria.

### Create personas

`POST /api/v2/personas`

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/personas" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d '{"personas": [{"name": "Late parcel", "prompt": "You are Dana Reed. Your parcel is five days late. Answer what you are asked in one short sentence.", "successCriteria": "The agent states the new delivery day.", "tags": ["practice"]}]}'
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `personas[].name` | Persona name |
| `personas[].prompt` | Instructions for the model that plays the caller |
| `personas[].successCriteria` | Text that the judge model checks after the call |
| `personas[].tags` | Array of strings |

The created personas are at `result.personas`, in request order. Each has an `id`.

### List personas

`GET /api/v2/personas`

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/personas" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

Not confirmed: the reference client only creates personas. The path above is the create route with `GET`. This is a list route, so it needs the workspace query parameter mentioned above. Take the parameters and result fields from https://docs.freyavoice.ai.

## Simulations

A simulation runs your agent against personas. In `chat` mode the conversation is text only.

### Create a simulation

`POST /api/v2/simulations`

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d '{
    "agentId": "AGENT_ID",
    "name": "practice run 1",
    "mode": "chat",
    "selectedPersonaIds": ["PERSONA_ID"],
    "customerVariablesMap": {"PERSONA_ID": {"customer_id": "c_123", "first_name": "Dana"}},
    "maxConcurrentCalls": 5,
    "runsPerPersona": 1,
    "maxCallDurationSeconds": 420,
    "assistantLlmOverride": {"provider": "experimental-5", "model": "experimental-5"},
    "routingLlmOverride": {"provider": "experimental-5", "model": "experimental-5"},
    "extractionLlmOverride": {"provider": "experimental-5", "model": "experimental-5"},
    "personaLlmOverride": {"provider": "google", "model": "gemini-3-flash-preview"},
    "analysisLlmOverride": {"provider": "google", "model": "gemini-3-flash-preview"}
  }'
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `agentId` | `workflow.agentId` from the create call |
| `name` | Name of the simulation |
| `mode` | `"chat"` for a text simulation |
| `selectedPersonaIds` | Persona ids to run |
| `customerVariablesMap` | Object keyed by persona id. Each value is the object of call variables for that persona's call |
| `maxConcurrentCalls` | How many calls run at the same time |
| `runsPerPersona` | Calls per persona |
| `maxCallDurationSeconds` | Limit for one call |
| `assistantLlmOverride` | Model for the dialogue call. Object with `provider` and `model` |
| `routingLlmOverride` | Model for the routing call |
| `extractionLlmOverride` | Model for the extraction call |
| `personaLlmOverride` | Model that plays the caller |
| `analysisLlmOverride` | Model that judges the success criteria |

Pass all three agent overrides (`assistantLlmOverride`, `routingLlmOverride`, `extractionLlmOverride`) on every simulation. An override you leave out falls back to the agent's default model. The values above are the ones the reference client uses. Use the models your event rules name.

The simulation id is at `result.simulation.id`.

### Poll a simulation

`GET /api/v2/simulations/{simulationId}`

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations/$SIM_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

Read `result.simulation.status`. Poll every 10 seconds until it is `completed`, `failed` or `paused`. Other status values are not listed in the sources.

### Talk to your workflow turn by turn

`POST /api/v2/chat/message` runs one turn against the published workflow, with no simulation and no queue. It answers in seconds, so it is the fastest way to see whether a workflow starts at all and what it says first.

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/chat/message" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
  -d '{"workflowId": "'$WORKFLOW_ID'", "message": "Hello?", "customerVariables": {"customer_id": "c_test", "first_name": "Daniel", "last_name": "Reyes", "title": "Mr", "now": "2026-10-14T11:00"}}'
```

`result` has `response` (what the phone agent said) and `callId`. Send the next turn with the same `callId`. End it with `POST /api/v2/chat/end` and `{"callId": "..."}`.

Seen in tests, not guaranteed: a long turn can return 504, and when the first step is a code step the chat route may skip it, so values that step computes are empty. A bare 500 here means the workflow cannot start a call at all.

### List iterations

`GET /api/v2/simulations/{simulationId}/iterations`

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations/$SIM_ID/iterations" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

An iteration is one execution of the simulation. The list is at `result.iterations`. The reference client takes the first entry's `id` right after a simulation finishes.

### Get an iteration's runs

`GET /api/v2/simulations/{simulationId}/iterations/{iterationId}`

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/simulations/$SIM_ID/iterations/$ITERATION_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

`result` has `iteration`, `runs` and `runsTotal`. A run is one call with one persona.

| Field of a run | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Run id |
| `callId` | Id of the call. Use it to fetch the transcript |
| `personaId`, `personaName` | The persona that played the caller |
| `outcome` | Result of the success criteria, for example `fail` |
| `reason` | The judge's explanation |
| `turnCount` | Number of turns |
| `startedAt`, `endedAt` | Timestamps |

The route returns 30 runs unless you ask for more. Pass `limit` (100 at most) and `offset`, and read until a page comes back short. Compare the number you read with `runsTotal`. `freya.get_iteration` does this for you.

While a simulation is running, `outcome` is `queued` or `running` for the runs that have not finished.

## Calls

### Get a call with its transcript

`GET /api/v2/call/{callId}`

```bash
curl -s "$FREYA_API_URL/api/v2/call/$CALL_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FREYA_API_KEY" \
  -H "User-Agent: $UA"
```

The call is at `result.call`.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `messages` | The event list of the call. See below |
| `transcript` | The conversation as one text string |
| `endedReason` | Why the call ended. For an `end_call` node it is the terminal's `function.name` |
| `duration` | Seconds |
| `successCriteriaResult` | Object with `success` and `reason` |

Each entry of `messages` has `role`, `message`, `nodeId`, `messageId` and `secondsFromStart`.

| `role` | `message` contains |
|---|---|
| `assistant` | What the agent said |
| `user` | What the caller said |
| `system` | A JSON string that describes one engine event |

System events seen in a trial call:

| `event` | Content |
|---|---|
| `node_enter` | `node`, `from_node`, `reason` |
| `function_call_start` | `function` and `args`. For an `api_call` the args are the full request: `url`, `method`, `headers`, `body` |
| `function_call_complete` | `function` and `result` |
| `route_evaluated` | `matched`, `from_node`, `target`, `reason`, a `branches` list with the result of every condition, and `variable_table` with all variables at that moment |
| `error` | `message` and `details` |

`route_evaluated` is the fastest way to learn why a transition did or did not fire. Each branch shows the variable, the operand and the result.

User and assistant messages in the trial call also carried a `workflowSnapshot` with `currentNode`, `previousNode`, `nodeTurnCount`, `totalTurnCount`, `transitionHistory`, `enteredNodes` and `variableTable`. Each entry of `variableTable` has `value`, `confidence`, `source` and `source_node`. Whether a query parameter is needed to receive the snapshots is not confirmed.

To check whether a variable arrived, read `variable_table` or `variableTable`. Finding the variable's name in a prompt or in a code body proves nothing about its value.

## A minimal loop

1. Build the workflow JSON.
2. `POST /api/v2/workflow?dryRun=true` and fix what it rejects.
3. `POST /api/v2/workflow`. Keep `workflow.agentId`.
4. `POST /api/v2/personas` once. Keep the ids.
5. `POST /api/v2/simulations` with the agent id, the persona ids and the call variables.
6. Poll `GET /api/v2/simulations/{id}` until the status is final.
7. `GET .../iterations`, then `GET .../iterations/{id}` for the runs.
8. For each failed run, `GET /api/v2/call/{callId}` and read the events.

For everything else, see https://docs.freyavoice.ai.

"""Builder for the Freya Bank statement-debt phone agent. Builds the workflow JSON, validates, saves+publishes, exports."""
import json, os, sys, pathlib, time
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import freya

MOCK = os.environ.get("BANK_MOCK_URL", "https://freya-bank-mock-fable.freya-faruk.workers.dev").rstrip("/") + "/voice/v1/"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared Python helpers for code nodes (no "{{" / "}}" allowed inside)
HELPERS = r'''
import json, re, datetime
MONTHS = ['Ocak','Şubat','Mart','Nisan','Mayıs','Haziran','Temmuz','Ağustos','Eylül','Ekim','Kasım','Aralık']
def _obj(v):
    if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, str):
        s = v.strip()
        if not s:
            return None
        try:
            return json.loads(s)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None
def _flat(prefix):
    out = dict()
    for k in list(vars.keys()):
        if isinstance(k, str) and k.startswith(prefix):
            rest = k[len(prefix):].split('.')
            cur = out
            for p in rest[:-1]:
                if not isinstance(cur.get(p), dict):
                    cur[p] = dict()
                cur = cur[p]
            cur[rest[-1]] = vars.get(k)
    return out
def _unflat(d):
    if isinstance(d, dict) and d and all(str(k).isdigit() for k in d.keys()):
        return [_unflat(d[k]) for k in sorted(d.keys(), key=lambda x: int(x))]
    if isinstance(d, dict):
        return dict((k, _unflat(v)) for k, v in d.items())
    return d
def _get_result(mapped_name, node_name):
    v = _obj(vars.get(mapped_name))
    if isinstance(v, dict) and v:
        return v
    f = _flat(node_name + '_response.data.data.')
    if f:
        return _unflat(f)
    f = _flat(node_name + '_response.data.')
    if isinstance(f, dict) and isinstance(f.get('data'), dict):
        return _unflat(f.get('data'))
    return None
def _status(node_name):
    for k in (node_name + '_status_code', node_name + '_response.status_code'):
        v = vars.get(k)
        if v is not None and str(v).strip():
            try:
                return int(float(str(v)))
            except Exception:
                pass
    return 0
def _num(x):
    try:
        if x is None or (isinstance(x, str) and not x.strip()):
            return None
        return float(x)
    except Exception:
        return None
def fmt_amount(x, cur):
    x = float(x)
    x = abs(x)
    whole = int(x + 1e-9)
    frac = int(round((x - whole) * 100))
    if frac >= 100:
        whole += 1
        frac = 0
    ws = format(whole, ',').replace(',', '.')
    sub = dict([('Türk Lirası', 'kuruş'), ('Dolar', 'sent'), ('Euro', 'sent'), ('İngiliz Sterlini', 'peni')]).get(cur, '')
    s = ws + ' ' + cur
    if frac:
        s += ' ' + str(frac) + ' ' + sub
    return s
def fmt_date(s):
    s = str(s or '').strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$', s)
    if not m:
        m2 = re.match(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})', s)
        if m2:
            return str(int(m2.group(3))) + ' ' + MONTHS[int(m2.group(2)) - 1] + ' ' + m2.group(1)
        return s
    return str(int(m.group(1))) + ' ' + MONTHS[int(m.group(2)) - 1] + ' ' + m.group(3)
def to_iso(s):
    s = str(s or '').strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$', s)
    if m:
        return '%s-%02d-%02d' % (m.group(3), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))
    return s[:10]
def today_iso():
    n = str(vars.get('now') or '').strip()
    if re.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', n):
        return n[:10]
    return datetime.date.today().isoformat()
def card_intro(name, last4):
    name = str(name or '').strip()
    if name:
        return 'Sonu ' + str(last4) + ' ile biten ' + name
    return 'Sonu ' + str(last4) + ' ile biten'
'''

CODE_PROCESS_CARDS = HELPERS + r'''
try:
    st = _status('fetch_cards')
    body = _get_result('cards_body', 'fetch_cards')
    cards = None
    if isinstance(body, dict):
        if isinstance(body.get('cards'), list):
            cards = body.get('cards')
        elif isinstance(body.get('data'), dict) and isinstance(body.get('data').get('cards'), list):
            cards = body.get('data').get('cards')
    if cards is None:
        cl = _obj(vars.get('cards_list'))
        if isinstance(cl, list):
            cards = cl
    rc = str(vars.get('cards_rc') or '')
    if cards is None:
        if st == 404 or rc == 'FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102':
            vars['cards_state'] = 'none'
        else:
            vars['cards_state'] = 'error'
        cards = []
    eligible = []
    supp = []
    for c in cards:
        if not isinstance(c, dict):
            continue
        num = str(c.get('cardNumber') or '')
        l4 = str(c.get('cardNumberLast4') or num[-4:])
        name = str(c.get('productName') or '').strip()
        main = str(c.get('isMainCard')).lower() in ('true', '1', 'yes')
        item = dict(num=num, last4=l4, name=name, first6=num[:6])
        if main:
            eligible.append(item)
        else:
            supp.append(item)
    if cards:
        vars['cards_state'] = 'one' if len(eligible) == 1 else ('multi' if len(eligible) > 1 else 'none')
    vars['eligible_cards_json'] = json.dumps(eligible, ensure_ascii=False)
    vars['eligible_count'] = str(len(eligible))
    vars['has_other_cards'] = 'yes' if len(eligible) > 1 else 'no'
    lines = []
    for i, c in enumerate(eligible):
        nm = c['name'] if c['name'] else '(ürün adı boş)'
        lines.append(str(i + 1) + ') ' + nm + ' - son dört hane ' + c['last4'] + ' - ilk altı hane ' + c['first6'])
    txt = '\n'.join(lines) if lines else '(uygun kart yok)'
    if supp:
        txt += '\nUygun OLMAYAN ek kartlar (sorgulanamaz, seçilemez): ' + ', '.join([(s['name'] or 'kart') + ' son dört hane ' + s['last4'] for s in supp])
    vars['cards_text'] = txt
    names = [c['name'] for c in eligible if c['name']]
    uniq = []
    for n in names:
        if n not in uniq:
            uniq.append(n)
    if len(uniq) >= 2:
        ex = 'Örneğin, ' + uniq[0] + ' veya ' + uniq[1] + ' diyebilirsiniz.'
    elif len(uniq) == 1:
        ex = 'Örneğin, ' + uniq[0] + ' diyebilirsiniz.'
    else:
        ex = ''
    vars['select_prompt'] = ('Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz? ' + ex).strip()
    if len(eligible) == 1:
        vars['selected_card_number'] = eligible[0]['num']
        vars['selected_card_last4'] = eligible[0]['last4']
        vars['selected_card_name'] = eligible[0]['name']
        vars['current_card_index'] = '1'
    else:
        vars['selected_card_number'] = ''
        vars['current_card_index'] = '0'
    vars['selected_card_index'] = '0'
    vars['next_action'] = 'stay'
    vars['select_action'] = 'stay'
    vars['week_changed'] = 'no'
    vars['email_sent'] = 'no'
    vars['has_email'] = 'unknown'
    vars['email'] = ''
    vars['email_spoken'] = ''
    vars['entry_text'] = ''
    vars['chosen_week'] = '0'
    vars['week_confirmation'] = 'none'
    vars['email_confirmation'] = 'none'
except Exception as e:
    vars['cards_state'] = 'error'
    vars['cards_text'] = ''
    vars['has_other_cards'] = 'no'
    vars['selected_card_index'] = '0'
    vars['next_action'] = 'stay'
    vars['select_action'] = 'stay'
'''

CODE_RESOLVE_CARD = HELPERS + r'''
try:
    eligible = _obj(vars.get('eligible_cards_json')) or []
    idx = vars.get('selected_card_index')
    try:
        idx = int(float(str(idx)))
    except Exception:
        idx = 0
    if 1 <= idx <= len(eligible):
        c = eligible[idx - 1]
        vars['selected_card_number'] = c['num']
        vars['selected_card_last4'] = c['last4']
        vars['selected_card_name'] = c['name']
        vars['current_card_index'] = str(idx)
        vars['card_resolved'] = 'ok'
    else:
        vars['card_resolved'] = 'bad'
    vars['selected_card_index'] = '0'
    vars['select_action'] = 'stay'
    vars['next_action'] = 'stay'
except Exception:
    vars['card_resolved'] = 'bad'
    vars['selected_card_index'] = '0'
'''

CODE_COMPOSE_READING = HELPERS + r'''
try:
    vars['selected_card_index'] = '0'
    vars['next_action'] = 'stay'
    vars['week_changed'] = 'no'
    vars['chosen_week'] = '0'
    vars['week_confirmation'] = 'none'
    vars['email_confirmation'] = 'none'
    # ---- e-mail
    em = _get_result('email_body', 'fetch_email')
    est = _status('fetch_email')
    email = ''
    ctype = ''
    if isinstance(em, dict):
        email = str(em.get('ibanEmail') or '').strip()
        ctype = str(em.get('communicationType') or '').strip()
    if email and ctype.lower() != 'phone':
        vars['has_email'] = 'yes'
        vars['email'] = email
        local = email.split('@')[0]
        dom = email.split('@')[1] if '@' in email else ''
        domname = dom.split('.')[0] if dom else ''
        simple = re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z]+(\.[a-zA-Z]+)?$', local) is not None and len(local) <= 24
        if simple:
            vars['email_spoken'] = email
        else:
            vars['email_spoken'] = local[0:1] + ' ile başlayan ' + (domname if domname else 'e-posta') + ' adresiniz'
    else:
        vars['has_email'] = 'no'
        vars['email'] = ''
        vars['email_spoken'] = ''
    vars['email_service_error'] = 'yes' if (em is None and est != 200) else 'no'
    # ---- balance
    bst = _status('fetch_balance')
    bal = _get_result('balance_body', 'fetch_balance')
    if not isinstance(bal, dict) or (not bal.get('statementDate') and not isinstance(bal.get('debtTL'), dict)):
        vars['balance_state'] = 'error'
        vars['entry_text'] = ''
        raise Exception('no balance')
    vars['balance_state'] = 'ok'
    last4 = str(bal.get('cardNumberLast4') or vars.get('selected_card_last4') or '')
    name = str(vars.get('selected_card_name') or bal.get('productName') or '').strip()
    st_raw = str(bal.get('statementDate') or '').strip()
    due_raw = str(bal.get('lastPayDate') or '').strip()
    vars['statement_date_raw'] = st_raw
    today = today_iso()
    st_iso = to_iso(st_raw) if st_raw else ''
    due_iso = to_iso(due_raw) if due_raw else ''
    status = str(bal.get('statementPaymentStatus') or '').upper()
    intro = card_intro(name, last4)
    blocks = [('debtTL', 'Türk Lirası'), ('debtUSD', 'Dolar'), ('debtEUR', 'Euro'), ('debtGBP', 'İngiliz Sterlini')]
    tl = bal.get('debtTL') if isinstance(bal.get('debtTL'), dict) else dict()
    parts = []
    multi = str(vars.get('has_other_cards')) == 'yes'
    if not st_raw:
        parts.append(intro + ' kartınızın henüz kesilmiş bir ekstresi bulunmadığı için ekstre borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.')
        vars['reading_kind'] = 'no_debt'
    elif status == 'NO_DEBT':
        total = _num(tl.get('totalDebt'))
        s = intro + ' kartınızın ' + fmt_date(st_raw) + ' tarihli ekstresinden borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.'
        if total is not None and total > 0:
            s += ' Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(total, 'Türk Lirası') + ' tutarındadır.'
        else:
            s += ' Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.'
        if due_raw:
            s += ' Son ödeme tarihiniz ' + fmt_date(due_raw) + ' olacaktır.'
        parts.append(s)
        vars['reading_kind'] = 'no_debt'
    else:
        vars['reading_kind'] = 'debt'
        if st_iso == today:
            parts.append('Hesap kesim tarihiniz bugün, ekstreniz saat 00.00 itibarıyla kesilecek.')
        due_passed = bool(due_iso) and due_iso < today
        read = []
        clear = []
        opening = intro + ' kartınıza ait ' + fmt_date(st_raw) + ' tarihinde kesilen ekstre '
        for key, cur in blocks:
            b = bal.get(key)
            if not isinstance(b, dict):
                continue
            rd = _num(b.get('remainingDebt'))
            sd = _num(b.get('statementDebt'))
            mp = _num(b.get('minPayment'))
            rmp = _num(b.get('remainingMinPayment'))
            bstat = str(b.get('statementPaymentStatus') or '').upper()
            has = (rd is not None and rd > 0) or (rd is None and sd is not None and sd > 0 and bstat != 'NO_DEBT')
            if not has:
                clear.append(cur)
                continue
            sd = sd if sd is not None else 0.0
            mp = mp if mp is not None else 0.0
            rd = rd if rd is not None else sd
            rmp = rmp if rmp is not None else mp
            if key == 'debtTL':
                if rmp > 0 and rmp >= mp:
                    s = 'Türk Lirası borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(sd, 'Türk Lirası') + ', ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ' + fmt_amount(mp, 'Türk Lirası') + ' tutarındadır.'
                elif rmp <= 0:
                    s = 'Türk Lirası borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(sd, 'Türk Lirası') + ', kalan toplam borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(rd, 'Türk Lirası') + ' tutarındadır. Minimum ödemenizi yaptığınız için teşekkür ederiz.'
                else:
                    s = 'Türk Lirası borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(sd, 'Türk Lirası') + ', ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ' + fmt_amount(mp, 'Türk Lirası') + ', kalan toplam borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(rd, 'Türk Lirası') + ', kalan minimum ödeme tutarınız ' + fmt_amount(rmp, 'Türk Lirası') + ' tutarındadır.'
            else:
                s = cur + ' borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(sd, cur) + ', kalan toplam borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(rd, cur) + ', ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ' + fmt_amount(mp, cur) + ' tutarındadır.'
            read.append(s)
        if read:
            read[0] = opening + read[0]
        else:
            read.append(intro + ' kartınıza ait ' + fmt_date(st_raw) + ' tarihinde kesilen ekstrenizde ödenmemiş borç görünmüyor.')
        parts.extend(read)
        if clear and len(clear) < 4:
            if len(clear) == 1:
                cs = clear[0]
            else:
                cs = ', '.join(clear[:-1]) + ' ve ' + clear[-1]
            parts.append(cs + ' borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.')
        if due_passed:
            apf = str(bal.get('automaticPaymentFlag') or '').upper()
            rap = _num(tl.get('remainAutomaticPaymentAmount'))
            if apf == 'Y' and rap is not None and rap > 0:
                parts.append('Otomatik ödeme talimatınızdan alınacak kalan tutar ' + fmt_amount(rap, 'Türk Lirası') + ' tutarındadır.')
            total = _num(tl.get('totalDebt'))
            s = 'Son ödeme tarihiniz ' + fmt_date(due_raw) + ' idi ve geçmiştir.'
            if total is not None and total > 0:
                s += ' Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam Türk Lirası borcunuz ' + fmt_amount(total, 'Türk Lirası') + ' tutarındadır.'
            parts.append(s)
        elif due_iso and due_iso == today:
            parts.append('Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz bugündür.')
        elif due_raw:
            parts.append('Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz ' + fmt_date(due_raw) + ' tarihidir.')
    reading = ' '.join(parts)
    vars['reading_text'] = reading
    he = vars.get('has_email') == 'yes'
    if he:
        offer = 'Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim ya da ekstrenizi kayıtlı mail adresinize gönderebilirim.'
    else:
        offer = 'Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim.'
    vars['offer_text'] = offer
    kind = vars.get('reading_kind')
    if multi:
        vars['entry_text'] = reading + ' Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?'
        vars['after_reading'] = 'ask'
    elif kind == 'no_debt':
        vars['entry_text'] = reading
        vars['after_reading'] = 'menu'
    else:
        vars['entry_text'] = reading + ' ' + offer
        vars['after_reading'] = 'ask'
    vars['offer_allowed'] = 'no' if kind == 'no_debt' else 'yes'
except Exception as e:
    if vars.get('balance_state') != 'error':
        vars['balance_state'] = 'error'
    vars['after_reading'] = 'error'
    if not vars.get('entry_text'):
        vars['entry_text'] = ''
'''

CODE_COMPOSE_WEEK = HELPERS + r'''
try:
    w = _get_result('week_body', 'fetch_week')
    if not isinstance(w, dict) or w.get('statementWeek') in (None, ''):
        vars['week_state'] = 'error'
        raise Exception('no week')
    vars['week_state'] = 'ok'
    cw = int(float(str(w.get('statementWeek'))))
    vars['current_week'] = str(cw)
    vars['statement_day'] = str(int(float(str(w.get('statementDay') or 0))))
    name = str(vars.get('selected_card_name') or w.get('productName') or '').strip()
    last4 = str(vars.get('selected_card_last4') or w.get('cardNumberLast4') or '')
    intro = card_intro(name, last4)
    rel = str(w.get('relationType') or '').strip().upper()
    rname = str(w.get('relatedCardProductName') or '').strip()
    rnum = str(w.get('relatedCardNumber') or '')
    rl4 = rnum[-4:] if rnum else ''
    nsd = fmt_date(w.get('nextStatementDate'))
    nld = fmt_date(w.get('nextLastPayDate'))
    if rel == 'M' and rname:
        s = intro + ' kartınız ile buna bağlı ' + card_intro(rname, rl4) + ' kartınız ortak ekstre kullanıyor; hesap kesim tarihi her ayın ' + str(cw) + '. haftası olarak tanımlı. Bir sonraki hesap kesim tarihiniz ' + nsd + ', son ödeme tarihiniz ' + nld + '.'
        vars['joint_text'] = 'Bu değişiklik kartınıza bağlı ' + rname + ' kartınızı da etkileyecek.'
    elif rel == 'C' and rname:
        s = intro + ' kartınız ile bu kartın bağlı olduğu ' + card_intro(rname, rl4) + ' kartınız ortak ekstre kullanıyor; hesap kesim tarihi her ayın ' + str(cw) + '. haftası olarak tanımlı. Bir sonraki hesap kesim tarihiniz ' + nsd + ', son ödeme tarihiniz ' + nld + '.'
        vars['joint_text'] = 'Bu değişiklik kartınızın bağlı olduğu ' + rname + ' kartınızı da etkileyecek.'
    else:
        s = intro + ' kartınızın hesap kesim tarihi her ayın ' + str(cw) + '. haftası olarak tanımlı. Bir sonraki hesap kesim tarihiniz ' + nsd + ', son ödeme tarihiniz ' + nld + '.'
        vars['joint_text'] = ''
    others = [str(i) for i in (1, 2, 3, 4) if i != cw]
    opts = others[0] + '., ' + others[1] + '. ya da ' + others[2] + '. haftasına'

def always(target):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}

def eq(target, desc, *pairs):
    """OR of equals pairs (variable, operand) — pairs may also be tuples of 3 for and-groups."""
    conds = []
    for p in pairs:
        if isinstance(p, list):
            conds.append({"logic": "and", "conditions": [{"variable": v, "operator": "equals", "operand": o} for v, o in p]})
        else:
            v, o = p
            conds.append({"variable": v, "operator": "equals", "operand": o})
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": conds}}

def gt(target, desc, variable, operand):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": variable, "operator": "greater_than", "operand": operand}]}}

def gt_and_eq(target, desc, variable, operand, v2, o2):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"logic": "and", "conditions": [
        {"variable": variable, "operator": "greater_than", "operand": operand}, {"variable": v2, "operator": "equals", "operand": o2}]}]}}

def tool_transition(target, desc):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "is_tool_call": True, "condition": {"operator": "matches_intent", "description": desc}}

def end_node(key, fn_name, text):
    return {"name": key, "node_type": "end_call", "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True, "transitions": [],
            "terminal": {"type": "function", "function": {"name": fn_name, "handler": "__function__:end_call",
                         "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "custom"},
                                                                          "spoken_message": {"type": "string", "default": text}}}}}}

def code_node(key, code, target, transitions=None):
    return {"name": key, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target, "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                             "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"code": {"type": "string", "default": code}, "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 15000}}}}}],
            "transitions": (transitions or []) + [always(target)]}

def api_node(key, service, body_fields, mappings, target, transitions=None, timeout=30000):
    """body_fields: dict field -> template value (string). Request body is {data: {...}, call: {...}} built in a pre-hook and as nested default."""
    data_default = {k: v for k, v in body_fields.items()}
    pre = ("try:\n"
           "    import json as _j\n"
           "    _fields = _j.loads(" + json.dumps(json.dumps(body_fields, ensure_ascii=False)) + ")\n"
           "    _data = dict()\n"
           "    for _k, _v in _fields.items():\n"
           "        _s = str(_v)\n"
           "        if _s.startswith('@'):\n"
           "            _val = vars.get(_s[1:])\n"
           "            _data[_k] = '' if _val is None else _val\n"
           "        else:\n"
           "            _data[_k] = _s\n"
           "    config['body'] = dict(data=_data, call=dict(ani='', lang='tr'))\n"
           "except Exception:\n"
           "    pass\n")
    assert "{{" not in pre and "}}" not in pre
    # nested default fallback (placeholders) in case the hook is not honoured
    nested = {}
    for k, v in body_fields.items():
        s = str(v)
        nested[k] = ("{{" + s[1:] + "}}") if s.startswith("@") else s
    props = {
        "url": {"type": "string", "default": MOCK + service},
        "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
        "connect_retries": {"type": "number", "default": 2},
        "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}, "Accept": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
        "body": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "data": {"type": "object", "default": nested},
            "call": {"type": "object", "default": {"ani": "", "lang": "tr"}}}},
    }
    return {"name": key, "node_type": "api_request", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target, "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "disable_inactivity_monitor": True, "suppress_tool_results": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout, "maxRetries": 0},
                             "function": {"name": key, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": service, "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": props}},
                             "pre_process_code": pre,
                             "post_process_code": "try:\n    if isinstance(result, dict):\n        result.pop('header', None)\nexcept Exception:\n    pass\n"}],
            "response_mapping": mappings,
            "transitions": (transitions or []) + [always(target)]}

N["end_agent_dispute"] = end_node("end_agent_dispute", "transfer_agent_dispute", "Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.")
N["end_service_error"] = end_node("end_service_error", "transfer_agent_service_error", "Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.")

N["end_silence"] = end_node("end_silence", "ended_silence", "Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.")

# sanity: every target exists
for k, n in N.items():
    for t in n.get("transitions", []):
        assert t["target_node"] in N, (k, t["target_node"])
    if n.get("passthrough_default_transition"):
        assert n["passthrough_default_transition"] in N, k
    if n.get("max_turn_transition"):

    out_dir = ROOT / "submission"; out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

"""Builder for the Freya Bank statement-debt phone agent. Builds the workflow JSON, validates, saves+publishes, exports."""
import json, os, sys, pathlib, time
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import freya

MOCK = os.environ.get("BANK_MOCK_URL", "https://freya-bank-mock-fable.freya-faruk.workers.dev").rstrip("/") + "/voice/v1/"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared Python helpers for code nodes (no "{{" / "}}" allowed inside)
HELPERS = r'''
import json, re, datetime
MONTHS = ['Ocak','Şubat','Mart','Nisan','Mayıs','Haziran','Temmuz','Ağustos','Eylül','Ekim','Kasım','Aralık']
def _obj(v):
    if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, str):
        s = v.strip()
        if not s:
            return None
        try:
            return json.loads(s)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None
def _flat(prefix):
    out = dict()
    for k in list(vars.keys()):
        if isinstance(k, str) and k.startswith(prefix):
            rest = k[len(prefix):].split('.')
            cur = out
            for p in rest[:-1]:
                if not isinstance(cur.get(p), dict):
                    cur[p] = dict()
                cur = cur[p]
            cur[rest[-1]] = vars.get(k)
    return out
def _unflat(d):
    if isinstance(d, dict) and d and all(str(k).isdigit() for k in d.keys()):
        return [_unflat(d[k]) for k in sorted(d.keys(), key=lambda x: int(x))]
    if isinstance(d, dict):
        return dict((k, _unflat(v)) for k, v in d.items())
    return d
def _get_result(mapped_name, node_name):
    v = _obj(vars.get(mapped_name))
    if isinstance(v, dict) and v:
        return v
    f = _flat(node_name + '_response.data.data.')
    if f:
        return _unflat(f)
    f = _flat(node_name + '_response.data.')
    if isinstance(f, dict) and isinstance(f.get('data'), dict):
        return _unflat(f.get('data'))
    return None
def _status(node_name):
    for k in (node_name + '_status_code', node_name + '_response.status_code'):
        v = vars.get(k)
        if v is not None and str(v).strip():
            try:
                return int(float(str(v)))
            except Exception:
                pass
    return 0
def _num(x):
    try:
        if x is None or (isinstance(x, str) and not x.strip()):
            return None
        return float(x)
    except Exception:
        return None
def fmt_amount(x, cur):
    x = float(x)
    x = abs(x)
    whole = int(x + 1e-9)
    frac = int(round((x - whole) * 100))
    if frac >= 100:
        whole += 1
        frac = 0
    ws = format(whole, ',').replace(',', '.')
    sub = dict([('Türk Lirası', 'kuruş'), ('Dolar', 'sent'), ('Euro', 'sent'), ('İngiliz Sterlini', 'peni')]).get(cur, '')
    s = ws + ' ' + cur
    if frac:
        s += ' ' + str(frac) + ' ' + sub
    return s
def fmt_date(s):
    s = str(s or '').strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$', s)
    if not m:
        m2 = re.match(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})', s)
        if m2:
            return str(int(m2.group(3))) + ' ' + MONTHS[int(m2.group(2)) - 1] + ' ' + m2.group(1)
        return s
    return str(int(m.group(1))) + ' ' + MONTHS[int(m.group(2)) - 1] + ' ' + m.group(3)
def to_iso(s):
    s = str(s or '').strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$', s)
    if m:
        return '%s-%02d-%02d' % (m.group(3), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))
    return s[:10]
def today_iso():
    n = str(vars.get('now') or '').strip()
    if re.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', n):
        return n[:10]
    return datetime.date.today().isoformat()
def card_intro(name, last4):
    name = str(name or '').strip()
    if name:
        return 'Sonu ' + str(last4) + ' ile biten ' + name
    return 'Sonu ' + str(last4) + ' ile biten'
'''

CODE_PROCESS_CARDS = HELPERS + r'''
try:
    st = _status('fetch_cards')
    body = _get_result('cards_body', 'fetch_cards')
    cards = None
    if isinstance(body, dict):
        if isinstance(body.get('cards'), list):
            cards = body.get('cards')
        elif isinstance(body.get('data'), dict) and isinstance(body.get('data').get('cards'), list):
            cards = body.get('data').get('cards')
    if cards is None:
        cl = _obj(vars.get('cards_list'))
        if isinstance(cl, list):
            cards = cl
    rc = str(vars.get('cards_rc') or '')

def always(target):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}

def eq(target, desc, *pairs):
    """OR of equals pairs (variable, operand) — pairs may also be tuples of 3 for and-groups."""
    conds = []
    for p in pairs:
        if isinstance(p, list):
            conds.append({"logic": "and", "conditions": [{"variable": v, "operator": "equals", "operand": o} for v, o in p]})
        else:
            v, o = p
            conds.append({"variable": v, "operator": "equals", "operand": o})
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": conds}}

def gt(target, desc, variable, operand):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": variable, "operator": "greater_than", "operand": operand}]}}

def gt_and_eq(target, desc, variable, operand, v2, o2):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"logic": "and", "conditions": [
        {"variable": variable, "operator": "greater_than", "operand": operand}, {"variable": v2, "operator": "equals", "operand": o2}]}]}}

def tool_transition(target, desc):
    return {"target_node": target, "description": desc, "is_tool_call": True, "condition": {"operator": "matches_intent", "description": desc}}

def end_node(key, fn_name, text):
    return {"name": key, "node_type": "end_call", "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True, "transitions": [],
            "terminal": {"type": "function", "function": {"name": fn_name, "handler": "__function__:end_call",
                         "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "custom"},
                                                                          "spoken_message": {"type": "string", "default": text}}}}}}

def code_node(key, code, target, transitions=None):
    return {"name": key, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target, "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                             "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"code": {"type": "string", "default": code}, "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 15000}}}}}],
            "transitions": (transitions or []) + [always(target)]}

def api_node(key, service, body_fields, mappings, target, transitions=None, timeout=30000):
    """body_fields: dict field -> template value (string). Request body is {data: {...}, call: {...}} built in a pre-hook and as nested default."""
    data_default = {k: v for k, v in body_fields.items()}
    pre = ("try:\n"
           "    import json as _j\n"
           "    _fields = _j.loads(" + json.dumps(json.dumps(body_fields, ensure_ascii=False)) + ")\n"
           "    _data = dict()\n"
           "    for _k, _v in _fields.items():\n"
           "        _s = str(_v)\n"
           "        if _s.startswith('@'):\n"
           "            _val = vars.get(_s[1:])\n"
           "            _data[_k] = '' if _val is None else _val\n"
           "        else:\n"
           "            _data[_k] = _s\n"
           "    config['body'] = dict(data=_data, call=dict(ani='', lang='tr'))\n"
           "except Exception:\n"
           "    pass\n")
    assert "{{" not in pre and "}}" not in pre
    # nested default fallback (placeholders) in case the hook is not honoured
    nested = {}
    for k, v in body_fields.items():
        s = str(v)
        nested[k] = ("{{" + s[1:] + "}}") if s.startswith("@") else s
    props = {
        "url": {"type": "string", "default": MOCK + service},
        "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
        "connect_retries": {"type": "number", "default": 2},
        "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}, "Accept": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
        "body": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "data": {"type": "object", "default": nested},
            "call": {"type": "object", "default": {"ani": "", "lang": "tr"}}}},
    }
    return {"name": key, "node_type": "api_request", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": target, "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
            "disable_inactivity_monitor": True, "suppress_tool_results": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout, "maxRetries": 0},
                             "function": {"name": key, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": service, "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": props}},
                             "pre_process_code": pre,
                             "post_process_code": "try:\n    if isinstance(result, dict):\n        result.pop('header', None)\nexcept Exception:\n    pass\n"}],
            "response_mapping": mappings,
            "transitions": (transitions or []) + [always(target)]}
