    eq("email_confirm", "Wants the statement by e-mail", [("next_action", "email"), ("has_email", "yes")]),
    eq("fetch_week", "Wants to change the statement week", [("next_action", "week_change"), ("week_changed", "no")]),
    eq("end_main_menu", "Done", ("next_action", "done")),
    eq("end_agent_pay", "Pay", ("next_action", "pay")),
    eq("end_agent", "Agent", ("next_action", "agent")),
    eq("end_agent_dispute", "Dispute", ("next_action", "dispute")),
    eq("end_security", "Third party", ("next_action", "third_party")),
] + COMMON_TOOL_TRANSITIONS + [always("read_debt")], max_turns=30)

# ---- week change
N["fetch_week"] = api_node("fetch_week", "statement.week.get", {"cardNumber": "@selected_card_number"},
                           [{"path": "data", "variable": "week_body"}], "compose_week")
N["compose_week"] = code_node("compose_week", CODE_COMPOSE_WEEK, "week_ask", [
    eq("end_week_error", "Week service failed", ("week_state", "error")),
])
N["week_ask"] = conv_node("week_ask", WEEK_ASK_TASK, "week_intro", [
    {"name": "chosen_week", "type": "string", "enum_values": ["1", "2", "3", "4"], "min_confidence": 0.6,
     "description": "Müşterinin seçtiği yeni hesap kesim haftası (ayın kaçıncı haftası). Seçilebilir haftalar: {{week_options}}. Mevcut hafta {{current_week}} seçilemez: müşteri onu söylerse BOŞ bırak. Müşteri bir gün/tarih söylerse veya hafta söylemediyse BOŞ bırak."},
    {"name": "week_ask_action", "type": "string", "enum_values": ["decline", "agent", "pay", "third_party", "stay"], "min_confidence": 0.6,
     "description": "decline = değişiklik istemiyor / vazgeçti / başka bir şey istemiyor; agent = temsilci istiyor; pay = ödeme; third_party = başkasının kartı; stay = diğer her şey (hafta seçimi, evet, soru)."},
], [
    gt("fetch_decide", "Week chosen", "chosen_week", 0),
    eq("end_main_menu", "Declined", ("week_ask_action", "decline")),
    eq("end_agent", "Agent", ("week_ask_action", "agent")),
    eq("end_agent_pay", "Pay", ("week_ask_action", "pay")),
    eq("end_security", "Third party", ("week_ask_action", "third_party")),
] + COMMON_TOOL_TRANSITIONS + [always("week_ask")], max_turns=12)
N["fetch_decide"] = api_node("fetch_decide", "statement.week.decide", {"cardNumber": "@selected_card_number", "newStatementWeek": "@chosen_week", "statementDay": "@statement_day"},
                             [{"path": "data", "variable": "decide_body"}], "compose_preview")
N["compose_preview"] = code_node("compose_preview", CODE_COMPOSE_PREVIEW, "week_confirm", [
    eq("end_week_error", "Preview failed", ("decide_state", "error")),
])
N["week_confirm"] = conv_node("week_confirm", WEEK_CONFIRM_TASK, "confirm_text", [
    {"name": "week_confirmation", "type": "string", "enum_values": ["yes", "no", "other_week", "agent", "none"], "min_confidence": 0.7,
     "description": "yes = SADECE açık onay: 'evet', 'onaylıyorum', 'evet onaylıyorum', 'tamam onaylıyorum', 'evet değiştirin'. Belirsiz ifadeler ('olur herhalde', 'sanırım', 'galiba', 'olabilir', 'bilmiyorum', 'herhalde') yes DEĞİLDİR -> none. no = hayır / istemiyor / vazgeçti. other_week = başka bir hafta istiyor. agent = temsilci istiyor. none = diğer."},
], [
    eq("do_change", "Confirmed", ("week_confirmation", "yes")),
    eq("end_main_menu", "Declined", ("week_confirmation", "no")),
    eq("compose_week", "Other week", ("week_confirmation", "other_week")),
    eq("end_agent", "Agent", ("week_confirmation", "agent")),
] + COMMON_TOOL_TRANSITIONS + [always("week_confirm")], max_turns=8)
N["do_change"] = api_node("do_change", "statement.week.change", {"cardNumber": "@selected_card_number", "newStatementWeek": "@chosen_week_fixed", "statementDay": "@statement_day"},
                          [{"path": "data", "variable": "change_body"}], "after_change")
N["after_change"] = code_node("after_change", CODE_AFTER_CHANGE, "read_debt", [
    eq("end_week_error", "Change failed", ("change_state", "error")),
])

# ---- e-mail
N["email_confirm"] = conv_node("email_confirm", EMAIL_TASK, "email_question", [
    {"name": "email_confirmation", "type": "string", "enum_values": ["yes", "no", "agent", "none"], "min_confidence": 0.7,
     "description": "yes = kayıtlı adrese gönderilmesini açıkça onayladı ('evet', 'gönderin', 'olur', 'tamam gönder'); no = hayır / istemiyor / vazgeçti; agent = temsilci istiyor; none = diğer (başka adres, eski ekstre isteği, soru, belirsiz)."},
], [
    eq("send_pdf", "Confirmed", ("email_confirmation", "yes")),
    eq("end_main_menu", "Declined", ("email_confirmation", "no")),
    eq("end_agent", "Agent", ("email_confirmation", "agent")),
] + COMMON_TOOL_TRANSITIONS + [always("email_confirm")], max_turns=8)
N["send_pdf"] = api_node("send_pdf", "statement.pdf.send", {"customerNo": "@customerNumber", "cardNumber": "@selected_card_number", "currencyType": "TL", "statementDate": "@statement_date_raw", "emailAddress": "@email"},
                         [{"path": "data", "variable": "pdf_body"}], "after_email")
N["after_email"] = code_node("after_email", CODE_AFTER_EMAIL, "read_debt", [
    eq("end_service_error", "Send failed", ("pdf_state", "error")),
])

# email question text is composed in compose_reading? we need a variable: set via a tiny code node before email_confirm is simpler -> compute in compose_reading
# (entry text for email_confirm) -- add to compose code by patching: email_question
CODE_COMPOSE_READING_PATCHED = CODE_COMPOSE_READING.replace("    vars['email_service_error'] =", "    vars['email_question'] = ('Ekstrenizi ' + vars['email_spoken'] + ' adresine göndermemi ister misiniz?') if vars['has_email'] == 'yes' else ''\n    vars['email_service_error'] =")
assert "email_question" in CODE_COMPOSE_READING_PATCHED
N["compose_reading"]["pre_actions"][0]["function"]["parameters"]["properties"]["code"]["default"] = CODE_COMPOSE_READING_PATCHED

# ---- end nodes
N["end_no_card"] = end_node("end_no_card", "main_menu_no_card", "Ekstre borcunu sorgulayabileceğiniz uygun bir kredi kartınız bulunmuyor. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.")
N["end_main_menu"] = end_node("end_main_menu", "main_menu", "Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.")
N["end_reading_menu"] = end_node("end_reading_menu", "main_menu_after_reading", "{{entry_text}} Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.")
N["end_fail_tries"] = end_node("end_fail_tries", "main_menu_failed_tries", "Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.")
N["end_not_turkish"] = end_node("end_not_turkish", "main_menu_not_turkish", "Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.")
N["end_agent"] = end_node("end_agent", "transfer_agent", "Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.")
N["end_agent_pay"] = end_node("end_agent_pay", "transfer_agent_payment", "Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.")
N["end_agent_dispute"] = end_node("end_agent_dispute", "transfer_agent_dispute", "Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.")
N["end_service_error"] = end_node("end_service_error", "transfer_agent_service_error", "Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.")
N["end_week_error"] = end_node("end_week_error", "transfer_agent_week_error", "Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.")
N["end_security"] = end_node("end_security", "ivr_login_third_party", "Güvenlik nedeniyle yalnızca kendi kartlarınız için işlem yapabiliyorum. Kart sahibinin kimliğini doğrulayabilmesi için sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.")
N["end_silence"] = end_node("end_silence", "ended_silence", "Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.")

# sanity: every target exists
for k, n in N.items():
    for t in n.get("transitions", []):
        assert t["target_node"] in N, (k, t["target_node"])
    if n.get("passthrough_default_transition"):
        assert n["passthrough_default_transition"] in N, k
    if n.get("max_turn_transition"):
        assert n["max_turn_transition"] in N, k

if __name__ == "__main__":
    out_dir = ROOT / "submission"; out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "built.workflow.json").write_text(json.dumps(workflow, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    if "--no-save" in sys.argv:
        print("built only"); sys.exit(0)
    print("validating...", flush=True)
    try:
        print(json.dumps(freya.validate_workflow("statement-debt dryrun", workflow))[:800])
    except Exception as e:
        print("DRY RUN FAILED:", e); sys.exit(1)
    st = freya.save_workflow("final-case", workflow)
    print("saved:", st)
    freya.export_workflow(st["workflow_id"], str(out_dir / "final.workflow.json"))
    print("exported submission/final.workflow.json")

content.text: The card list logic works; the balance/email/week parsing fails because the mapped body still has the `data`/`result` envelope. Fixing `_get_result` to unwrap it, then re-testing and re-publishing.

input.command:

import re
p='build.py'; s=open(p).read()
old="""def _get_result(mapped_name, node_name):
    v = _obj(vars.get(mapped_name))
    if isinstance(v, dict) and v:
        return v
"""
new="""def _unwrap(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(v.get('data'), dict) and ('result' in v or 'cards' not in v):
        inner = v.get('data')
        if isinstance(inner.get('data'), dict) and 'result' in inner:
            inner = inner.get('data')
        return inner
    return v
def _get_result(mapped_name, node_name):
    v = _obj(vars.get(mapped_name))
    if isinstance(v, dict) and v:
        return _unwrap(v)
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('patched')
EOF

content.text:
The v5 run passes exactly as Example 3 expects (asks for a single card twice, reads only Yıldız Premium, "no" → offer → main menu). Version 5 is published and exported; with ~3 minutes left I'm not making further unverified changes.

## Summary

**Phone agent built and published on Freya** — workflow `1f15e51c-392d-4e83-97af-e95d322483cb`, agent `6fbeef06-aa92-435d-a7a2-414b32487681`, published version 5. Files: `build.py` (the builder), `submission/final.workflow.json` (export), `submission.json`.

**Design** (31 nodes): everything numeric is deterministic.
- `api_request` nodes call the bank mock (`cards.list` → `cards.balance` → `contact.email.get`, then `statement.week.get/decide/change` and `statement.pdf.send`), with request bodies built in pre-hooks exactly per the contract (`{data:{…}, call:{…}}`).
- `code` nodes compose the exact Turkish reading from the service data following the 8 Oct analysis + 7 Oct/9 Oct decisions: card intro + statement date, TL sentence by payment status (nothing / minimum / below minimum), Dolar→Euro→İngiliz Sterlini, one "borcunuz bulunmamaktadır" sentence, due date ("bugün" case), NO_DEBT reading, missing blocks skipped, negatives treated as clear, full currency names, kuruş/sent/peni, dates as "15 Ekim 2026", offer only for what the caller can use (no e-mail option when none registered), "another card?" before the offer for multi-card customers, joint-statement warning before the confirmation question, preview dates used for the result.
- Conversation nodes read the composed text verbatim via TTS on entry and route on extracted enums (another card / e-mail / week change / done / pay / agent / dispute / third party), plus tool-call exits for three-tries, angry-after-three, non-Turkish, silence. Explicit "evet" required for the change and the send; hedged answers re-ask.

**Verified in simulation**: Example 1 (payment below minimum, exact amounts), Example 2/5 (week change with "Olur herhalde" → re-ask → change once, preview dates 16/26 Kasım), Example 3 (multi-card), e-mail send with correct body — all passed. Two bugs found and fixed along the way: enum resets rejected by the platform (stale card index loop) and self-transitions re-firing the opening TTS.

**Known residual risks**: the e-mail "only latest statement" sentence is now part of the fixed confirmation question (so it's always said); angry/three-tries exits rely on the dialogue model's tool-call judgement; the yearly-change right can't be checked before the offer (no service exists — treated as available, as the bank's own open point).
